newsitem.title: FRANCE: Promodes rallies after Italian takeover.
newsitem.headline: Promodes rallies after Italian takeover.

text.p: Shares in French retailer Promodes were up more than three percent in early trading on the Paris bourse on Wednesday as investors applauded its move to acquire control of Italy's hyper and supermarkets concern Gruppo G.
"The market is reacting positively to this news -- to any news of expansion abroad -- because French retailers can only expand now if they expand abroad," one trader said.
New laws limiting the opening of new outlets and store expansions have restricted French retailers' potential for domestic growth.
Promodes's stock was up 42 francs, or 3.18 percent, at 1,363 at 0910 GMT.
Another trader said the stock's gains were also due to the fact that it has lagged other French retail stocks such as Carrefour, which was slightly lower on Wednesday.
Promodes said on Tuesday it had raised its stake in Gruppo G to 80 percent from 34.5 percent.
